== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)#Source formats|Son Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif Holotable image repository, commit efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.
